title: A1 preview Program B Handoff
description: Immutable, closed A1 closeout record for one published opt-in preview candidate. It proves only A1 opt-in preview completion and requires separate authorization before Program B or Program C work begins.
$comment: Semantic admission resolves every github_artifact_file_reference, verifies raw-byte SHA-256, validates the resolved typed records, and enforces cross-record equality. CANONICAL_MAIN_BINDING requires source_ref, candidate.source.ref, and candidate.build.ref to equal refs/heads/main; source_commit, candidate.source.commit, candidate.source.origin_main_target, and candidate.build.commit to be equal; and the candidate post-merge receipt scanned_commit and tag_target to equal source_commit. PROMOTION_ATTEMPT_BINDING requires promotion_attempt to resolve to promotion-attempt.schema.json; promotion_attempt_id to equal its attempt_id; its candidate, Candidate Identity Record SHA-256, and decision reference and SHA-256 to equal the handoff; authorization.decision_authorization to equal the Decision promotion_attempt template; and the current GitHub actor, workflow run, and permission readback to equal the Decision authorized dispatcher and captured run context. REMOTE_ATTEMPT_BINDING requires the resolved Remote Observation and Remote Classification promotion_attempt_id values, and the resolved Remote Verification promotion_attempt_id and promotion_attempt reference, to equal the handoff lineage. STAGE_SET_EQUALITY requires pre_decision_stage_evidence, pre_publication_stage_evidence, and post_publication_stage_evidence each to resolve to a stage-gate-evidence.schema.json record that binds the same Candidate Identity Record, candidate binding, source ref, source commit, origin-main target, build run, and Release Gate Catalog as the handoff; whose stage equals pre-decision, pre-publication, or post-publication respectively; whose derived catalog descriptor subset matches its evidence field-for-field in order; and whose outcome is PASS. The handoff has no self-hash; an enclosing github_artifact_file_reference stores the raw handoff hash.

pre_decision_stage_evidence.description: Passing Stage Gate Evidence for the catalog's pre-decision descriptor subset: retained proof, seven-lens aggregate, distinct independent PR review, and candidate exact-head Sonar.

pre_publication_stage_evidence.description: Passing Stage Gate Evidence for the catalog's pre-publication descriptor subset: post-merge exact-head Sonar whose scanned commit and tag target equal the candidate commit.

post_publication_stage_evidence.description: Passing Stage Gate Evidence for the catalog's post-publication descriptor subset: fresh remote consumer and byte proof after the prerelease is public.
